title: Real Metal
meta_description: Real Metal is an AI-generated Diesel jewellery campaign staged inside Diesel-Land and shot entirely through security-camera framing.
deck: An AI-generated fashion campaign made for the Runway AI Film Festival, asking whether authenticity survives an artificial system — and answering in the language of a security camera.

proof.title: Shot as evidence, not as advertising.
proof.note: A jewellery campaign usually shows metal in a lightbox. Here every frame is presented as a recovered camera feed, so the hardware reads as something caught rather than something styled.

shots.alt: Overhead security-camera frame of a woman in denim looking up at an illuminated DIESEL-LAND sign above a metal detector, with REC and CAM 84 overlaid on the image.
shots.caption: Cam 84 / entry

shots.alt: The same overhead camera angle as two men pass through the DIESEL-LAND gate, one pointing at the lens, the frame timestamped 2026-04-27.
shots.caption: Cam 84 / gate

proof.caption: Diesel-Land is a checkpoint, and the campaign never leaves it. Chains, hardware, and denim all read as things you would be asked to remove before walking through.

acts.title: Real metal, real attitude.
acts.note: The campaign is built on one question and keeps returning to it rather than resolving it.

items.title: The checkpoint
items.copy: A gate that scans for metal, standing in a world built to sell it.

items.title: The subjects
items.copy: Faces that know they are being recorded and hold the lens anyway.

items.title: The verdict
items.copy: The question is not whether the metal is real, but whether the attitude is.

pipeline.title: Pipeline.
pipeline.note: Generated end to end, then graded and framed so the artificial origin becomes part of the argument instead of something to hide.

items.label: Board
items.copy: Campaign concept and shot order fixed before a single frame was generated.

items.label: Generate
items.copy: Character, wardrobe, and set continuity carried across every camera position.

items.label: Grade
items.copy: A desaturated concrete palette, so the red sign and the chrome are the only colour left.

items.label: Frame
items.copy: The CCTV overlay applied last: camera number, timestamp, recording state.
